integrity.finite_check_scope: 4094 nonempty binary words through length 11 and construction for 1<=k<=9
integrity.review_caveat: Self-review only; independent validation not performed.

scientific_limitations: The sharp count is proved for minimal absent scattered subsequences of words over the fixed binary alphabet, parameterized by source one-count; it is not a bound for absent substrings or all absent subsequences.
The theorem does not classify all extremizing source words or extend to larger alphabets.
An unindexed equivalent may exist despite checks against the closest accessible literature.
title: Sharp binomial profile of minimal absent subsequences under a fixed letter count
